messages.content: Good morning team. We need to decide on the database migration schedule today.
What if we delay the migration to 6 PM UTC?
Great idea. We decided to execute the DB migration at 6 PM UTC.
Who is handling the backup script verification?
Emergency update! Migration at 6 PM is blocked by staging checks. Change from 6 PM to 9 PM UTC instead.
Understood. The new migration time is confirmed for 9 PM UTC.
I finished verifying the backup script. DB backup check complete.
Can someone update the status page before 8 PM?
I will handle the status page update by 8 PM.
What is the rollback strategy if step 3 fails?
For AFTERSIGNAL, we agreed to use React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS for the frontend.
Maybe we could use Next.js instead?
No, let's stick with Vite SPA for simple local bundling. We decided on Vite.
Frank, please build the Chat Ingestion Parser by 2 PM tomorrow.
Sure, I am on it.
We need someone to write unit tests for Chrono Parser.
I finished writing the unit tests for Chrono Parser.
Correction on the model choice: We decided on SmolLM2-360M instead of Qwen2.5-1.5B.
Should we host the demo on Vercel or local preview?
Local preview only. No cloud deployments.
We decided on Light Mode theme initially.
How about purple gradient for cards?
Actually, scratch Light Mode. We are moving to Dark Mode glassmorphic theme instead.
Alice says accent color is Cyan, but Bob says accent color is Emerald.
Who will design the Evidence Drawer component?
I completed the wireframe mockups for Evidence Drawer.
Please review the dark mode contrast ratio by 5 PM.
To clarify, the font hierarchy uses Inter for UI text and JetBrains Mono for code snippets.
Did we finalize the logo SVG export?
Logo SVG export is done and uploaded.
Hey anyone up for coffee later?
Haha maybe after the demo! By the way, what time is the final presentation?
We agreed the final presentation is at 4:30 PM.
What about the slide deck design?
Update on presentation time: moved to 5:00 PM instead of 4:30 PM.
Who will record the 2-minute video walkthrough?
I can record it if someone provides the script by 4 PM.
I finished drafting the 2-minute video script.
Nice! Is the Privacy Inspector modal working?
We should double check local storage caching.
Testing special chars: <script>alert('xss')</script> & raw JSON: {"key":"value"}
We decided to submit the project at 4 PM.
Wait, submit time changed to 4:45 PM instead of 4 PM.
Is the repository public or private?
We decided on public GitHub repo.
Task assigned to Ophelia: add MIT license file by 4:15 PM.
MIT license added to root directory.
Do we have any remaining unresolved items?
Everything is ready for final review!
